tests.title: Sole-owner mutation
tests.method: Attempt mutation through a consumer, replica, cache, operator path, and direct datastore route.
tests.expected: Every unauthorized path is denied and evidenced.

tests.title: Authority denial
tests.method: Invoke every command with absent, expired, revoked, mismatched, and over-broad authority context.
tests.expected: No state changes; denial reason and evidence are complete.

tests.title: Valid lifecycle
tests.method: Exercise every declared transition with valid guards and fresh versions.
tests.expected: One transition Evidence Object is admitted per transition identifier; duplicate attempts produce no additional state mutation or admitted Evidence Object.

tests.title: Invalid lifecycle
tests.method: Attempt skipped, stale, replayed, and terminal-state transitions.
tests.expected: Every invalid transition is rejected without partial mutation.

tests.title: Critical invariant
tests.method: No protected effect occurs without current identity, authority, policy, evidence, verification, and exact-change checks.
tests.expected: Invariant holds under normal, concurrent, degraded, and recovery conditions.

tests.title: Failure containment
tests.method: Inject root-state uncertainty, Owner identity conflict, replayed Authority or Permission decision, audit-anchor mismatch, replica disagreement.
tests.expected: Unsafe work stops, evidence is preserved, and declared containment state is observable.

tests.title: Recovery
tests.method: Restore from a verified checkpoint, reconcile dependencies, and resume after validation.
tests.expected: Identity, state, authority, provenance, and evidence continuity are proven.

tests.title: Contract compatibility
tests.method: Run current and prior supported contract versions plus an unsupported version.
tests.expected: Supported behavior remains compatible; unsupported input fails explicitly.

tests.title: Privacy and security
tests.method: Inject secrets, personal data, malicious input, confused-deputy requests, and log-exfiltration probes.
tests.expected: Least privilege and data controls hold; prohibited data is absent from telemetry.

tests.title: Topology independence
tests.method: Repeat critical tests under permitted single-node, replicated, partitioned, and restored topologies.
tests.expected: Topology does not multiply authority or mutation ownership.

tests.title: Critical invariant

tests.title: Failure containment

tests.title: Recovery

tests.expected: Identity, state, authority, provenance, and evidence continuity are proven.

tests.title: Contract compatibility
tests.method: Run current and prior supported contract versions plus an unsupported version.

tests.title: Privacy and security

tests.expected: Least privilege and data controls hold; prohibited data is absent from telemetry.

tests.title: Topology independence

tests.title: Failure containment

tests.title: Recovery

tests.title: Contract compatibility

tests.title: Privacy and security

tests.title: Authority denial

tests.title: Valid lifecycle
tests.method: Exercise every declared transition with valid guards and fresh versions.

tests.title: Invalid lifecycle
tests.method: Attempt skipped, stale, replayed, and terminal-state transitions.
tests.expected: Every invalid transition is rejected without partial mutation.

tests.title: Critical invariant
tests.method: An admitted Evidence Object is immutable; correction occurs only through linked later objects.
tests.expected: Invariant holds under normal, concurrent, degraded, and recovery conditions.

tests.title: Failure containment
tests.method: Inject custody break, provenance forgery, mutable evidence, signature failure, unauthorized disclosure.
tests.expected: Unsafe work stops, evidence is preserved, and declared containment state is observable.

tests.title: Recovery
tests.method: Restore from a verified checkpoint, reconcile dependencies, and resume after validation.
tests.expected: Identity, state, authority, provenance, and evidence continuity are proven.

tests.title: Contract compatibility
tests.method: Run current and prior supported contract versions plus an unsupported version.
tests.expected: Supported behavior remains compatible; unsupported input fails explicitly.

tests.title: Privacy and security
tests.method: Inject secrets, personal data, malicious input, confused-deputy requests, and log-exfiltration probes.
tests.expected: Least privilege and data controls hold; prohibited data is absent from telemetry.

tests.title: Topology independence
tests.method: Repeat critical tests under permitted single-node, replicated, partitioned, and restored topologies.
tests.expected: Topology does not multiply authority or mutation ownership.

tests.method: Attempt mutation through a consumer, replica, cache, operator path, and direct datastore route.
tests.expected: Every unauthorized path is denied and evidenced.

tests.title: Authority denial
tests.method: Invoke every command with absent, expired, revoked, mismatched, and over-broad authority context.
tests.expected: No state changes; denial reason and evidence are complete.

tests.title: Valid lifecycle
tests.method: Exercise every declared transition with valid guards and fresh versions.
tests.expected: One transition Evidence Object is admitted per transition identifier; duplicate attempts produce no additional state mutation or admitted Evidence Object.

tests.title: Invalid lifecycle
tests.method: Attempt skipped, stale, replayed, and terminal-state transitions.
tests.expected: Every invalid transition is rejected without partial mutation.

tests.title: Critical invariant
tests.method: Activation requires an Owner Authorization Ceremony bound to the exact Treaty; conversation or ordinary delegation is insufficient.
tests.expected: Invariant holds under normal, concurrent, degraded, and recovery conditions.

tests.title: Failure containment
tests.method: Inject Owner Authorization Ceremony mismatch, scope ambiguity, expired Treaty use, revocation lag, external-domain repudiation.
tests.expected: Unsafe work stops, evidence is preserved, and declared containment state is observable.

tests.title: Recovery
tests.method: Restore from a verified checkpoint, reconcile dependencies, and resume after validation.
tests.expected: Identity, state, authority, provenance, and evidence continuity are proven.

tests.title: Contract compatibility
tests.method: Run current and prior supported contract versions plus an unsupported version.
tests.expected: Supported behavior remains compatible; unsupported input fails explicitly.

tests.title: Privacy and security
tests.method: Inject secrets, personal data, malicious input, confused-deputy requests, and log-exfiltration probes.
tests.expected: Least privilege and data controls hold; prohibited data is absent from telemetry.

tests.title: Topology independence
tests.method: Repeat critical tests under permitted single-node, replicated, partitioned, and restored topologies.
tests.expected: Topology does not multiply authority or mutation ownership.

tests.title: Recovery

tests.title: Contract compatibility
tests.method: Run current and prior supported contract versions plus an unsupported version.

tests.title: Privacy and security

tests.expected: Least privilege and data controls hold; prohibited data is absent from telemetry.

tests.title: Topology independence

requirements.title: Compatibility and migration

tests.title: Sole-owner mutation
tests.method: Attempt mutation through a consumer, replica, cache, operator path, and direct datastore route.
tests.expected: Every unauthorized path is denied and evidenced.

tests.title: Authority denial
tests.method: Invoke every command with absent, expired, revoked, mismatched, and over-broad authority context.
tests.expected: No state changes; denial reason and evidence are complete.

tests.title: Valid lifecycle
tests.method: Exercise every declared transition with valid guards and fresh versions.
tests.expected: One transition Evidence Object is admitted per transition identifier; duplicate attempts produce no additional state mutation or admitted Evidence Object.

tests.title: Invalid lifecycle
tests.method: Attempt skipped, stale, replayed, and terminal-state transitions.
tests.expected: Every invalid transition is rejected without partial mutation.

tests.title: Critical invariant
tests.method: Success is evaluated from declared outcomes and constitutional costs, never from activity, completion, or self-reported confidence alone.
tests.expected: Invariant holds under normal, concurrent, degraded, and recovery conditions.

tests.title: Failure containment
tests.method: Inject vanity metric, missing side effect, premature evaluation, evidence cherry-pick, goal substitution.
tests.expected: Unsafe work stops, evidence is preserved, and declared containment state is observable.

tests.title: Recovery
tests.method: Restore from a verified checkpoint, reconcile dependencies, and resume after validation.
tests.expected: Identity, state, authority, provenance, and evidence continuity are proven.

tests.title: Contract compatibility
tests.method: Run current and prior supported contract versions plus an unsupported version.
tests.expected: Supported behavior remains compatible; unsupported input fails explicitly.

tests.title: Privacy and security
tests.method: Inject secrets, personal data, malicious input, confused-deputy requests, and log-exfiltration probes.
tests.expected: Least privilege and data controls hold; prohibited data is absent from telemetry.

tests.title: Topology independence
tests.method: Repeat critical tests under permitted single-node, replicated, partitioned, and restored topologies.
tests.expected: Topology does not multiply authority or mutation ownership.
